name: Claude
summary: Anthropic’s assistant for chat, writing, files, and coding.
description: Claude is Anthropic’s assistant, not a frozen “Claude 3” release. On the pricing page checked via search on 21 October 2026, Free is $0 and includes chat on the web, desktop, and mobile. Pro is $20 a month, or $17 a month when billed annually, and adds more usage plus Claude Code. Max starts at $100 a month.

pricing.note: Free $0. Pro $20/month or $17/month billed annually. Max from $100/month.

features: Long Context Handling: Processes documents up to 200K tokens.
Safety & Alignment: Optimized for reliable, safe responses.
Creative Writing: Generates detailed, imaginative content.
Helpful for Research: Answers questions based on long-form material.
